newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bank of Spain buying pesetas at 85.00 per mark.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Spain buying pesetas at 85.00 per mark.

text.p: The Bank of Spain was buying pesetas at 85.00 per mark, dealers said on Monday.
At around 1050 GMT the peseta was trading at around 84.97/85.00 per mark, weakened from an opening level of 84.95/97 and early trade around 84.89/90.
The Bank of Spain declined to comment, in line with its usual policy.
"The Bank of Spain was back in the market buying at around 85 per mark," a dealer in Madrid said.
The central bank, which cut its key money market rate by 25 basis points to 5.75 percent last week, was also seen buying pesetas in the market on Monday.
